ask.label: Agent
ask.recentEmpty: No conversations on this computer yet.
ask.clearNone: Nothing can be cleared right now. Conversations that are running, waiting or still being checked stay in the list, and so do some that recovery keeps.
ask.clearNoLocks: This browser can't clear the list safely right now. Nothing was changed.
ask.clearConfirm_one: Remove {{count}} finished conversation from this list? It stays on {{computer}}. Find it in AI > Chats. Running, waiting, unconfirmed and still-checking ones stay.
ask.clearConfirm_other: Remove {{count}} finished conversations from this list? They stay on {{computer}}. Find them in AI > Chats. Running, waiting, unconfirmed and still-checking ones stay.
ask.clearSame: Nothing to remove: the list changed meanwhile.
ask.clearUnreadable: Couldn't read the list in this browser. Nothing was changed.
ask.clearFull: This browser's storage is full. Nothing was changed.
ask.clearAccount: The account changed, so nothing was cleared.
ask.clearStale: The list changed while checking, so nothing was removed. Try again.
ask.clearNothing: Couldn't change the list. It shows what this browser holds now.
ask.clearSome: Some conversations were removed. The list shows what this browser holds now.
ask.clearUnconfirmed: Couldn't check whether the list changed.
ask.recentFull: Recent is full of conversations that are still running or waiting to be checked, so this one isn't listed there yet. It stays open here.
ask.openInAiTip: Shows this conversation on the AI page, with more room, and closes this panel.
ask.openInAiNone: Nothing to open yet. Send a message first.
ask.newConfirm: The current task keeps running. Start a new conversation?
ask.newConfirmUnsure: Your first message may have gone through, and its check goes with this conversation. Start a new conversation?
ask.freshWaitsCheck: Check the unconfirmed message above first; your text goes to a new conversation after that.
ask.newWait: Wait until what you sent is settled.
ask.tRealmNote: Change it in the realm menu at the top.
ask.tModelValue: Uses the model set on this computer
ask.tOwnValue: Claude Code, Codex and others work with Hoody too
ask.firstBody: Your agent works right on this computer. It builds, runs and fixes things, and asks before anything risky.
ask.welcome: This agent is great for quick, everyday tasks on your computers, and for bigger projects Hoody runs best from your own favourite agent, like Claude Code or Codex, connected remotely.
ask.s.running.p: What is running on this computer right now? List the main processes and open ports.
ask.s.space.p: How much disk space and memory is free on this computer? Flag anything close to full.
ask.s.update.p: Check this computer for package updates and list what would change. Do not install anything yet.
ask.s.site.p: Build me a small website on this computer and tell me its link.
ask.s.appsList.p: Which apps are installed on this computer, and which of them are running?
ask.s.appsFail.p: One of my apps will not start. Find out why and tell me what to fix.
ask.s.scrWrite.p: Help me write a small script. Ask me what it should do first.
ask.s.scrFail.p: My last script run failed. Read its output and explain why.
ask.s.scrSched.p: Help me run one of my scripts on a schedule. Ask me which script and how often.
ask.s.logErr.p: Explain the most recent errors in this computer's logs and what to do about them.
ask.s.logRepeat.p: Is anything in the logs failing again and again? Group it and tell me what matters most.
ask.s.schFail.p: My last scheduled run failed. Find out why and tell me what to change.
ask.s.schNext.p: What is scheduled to run next on this computer, and when?
ask.s.notesRecent.p: Summarize my most recent notes in a few lines.
ask.noComputer: Pick a computer to ask its agent
ask.provisioning: {{computer}} is being set up · usually 1-2 minutes
ask.withheld: Can't reach this computer right now.
ask.lost: Connection lost. Your agent may still be working.
ask.busy: This agent is busy with another task.
ask.unsupported: The agent on {{computer}} can't take requests from the Hub yet.
ask.otherAccount: This agent is signed in to another Hoody account.
ask.accessRefused: Access to this agent was refused.
ask.identityUnknown: The agent did not say which account it is signed in to. Try again in a moment.
ask.pickRealmTop: Pick one realm from the realm menu at the top (on a phone, tap the realm square) to ask this computer's agent.
ask.pinned: This agent works only in another realm. Pick that realm from the realm menu at the top (on a phone, tap the realm square).
ask.realmNeeded: This computer is not in the realm picked at the top.
ask.gone: This chat is no longer on the computer. Start a new chat to go on.
ask.goneOrUnreachable: This chat is gone or not reachable.
ask.cantOpenHere: This chat can't be opened here right now. Try again in a moment.
ask.blockedBody.failed: Open Computers to see what happened and start it again.
ask.blockedBody.refused: The agent turned the Hub away. Check who may use it in the Agent app, then try again.
ask.blockedBody.retry: If this keeps happening, the Guide explains what this panel needs from the agent on your computer.
ask.followUp: Your agent reads this at its next step
ask.followUnsupported: Wait for the reply, or Stop
ask.waitEarlier: Wait until your last message is sent
ask.checkLastFirst: Check your last message first: it may have gone through
ask.afterGateNote: Your agent reads this after you answer the request. To decline it, use Deny.
ask.afterQuestionNote: Your agent reads this after you answer its question.
ask.signInNote: Sending also signs this agent in to your Hoody account.
ask.prefillFrom: From {{source}} · edit it, then press Enter
ask.dismissNote: Stopping tracking doesn't cancel the message. Sending it again may repeat the work.
ask.autoTip: Your agent runs each action without asking first. Turn it off to approve actions one by one.
ask.autoFailOn: Could not turn on Allow everything. Your agent still asks when an action needs you.
ask.autoFailOff: Could not turn off Allow everything. Try again.
ask.autoStartFail: Allow everything could not be armed. Your agent asks when an action needs you.
ask.autoLocked: This agent's approval policy is set in the Agent app.
ask.autoUnknown: Allow everything may not have changed. Check the switch again in a moment.
ask.autoHeld: A change to this chat's approvals is still being saved. Switch once it is done.
ask.autoMaybe: A change to this chat's approvals may have gone through. Check again before switching.
ask.autoConfirmBody: Your agent will run every action in this chat without asking you first, as you: commands, file changes and deletions, and some actions normally kept for a person. Deny rules still win. Questions, hooks that ask and connected tool servers that confirm each call still wait for you.
ask.dupSame: This message is already waiting (sent earlier).
ask.dupEarlier: A message sent earlier is still waiting, and its text isn't kept after a reload. If this is the same message, it's already waiting.
ask.notStarted: The agent has no turn for it.
ask.queued: Your agent reads this at its next step
ask.queuedNext.hint: Images can't join a reply that is already running. Send queues this message for when the reply ends.
ask.queuedNext.hintGate: Images can't join a reply that is already running. Send queues this message for when the reply ends, after you answer the request.
ask.queuedNext.on: Queued. Sends when this reply ends, while this stays open. You can still change it.
ask.queuedNext.onGate: Queued. Sends when this reply ends, after you answer the request, while this stays open. You can still change it.
ask.queuedNext.sendWhy: Already queued: it sends when this reply ends
ask.queuedNext.left: Your queued message was not sent: this was closed before the reply ended. Check it, then send it again.
ask.queuedNext.kept: The reply ended, but your queued message was not sent. It is still here.
ask.queuedNext.command: Commands aren't sent automatically. Press Send.
ask.queuedNext.empty: It has no text. Type a message to send with the files.
ask.queuedNext.long: It is too long. Shorten the text.
ask.queuedGate: Queued. Your agent reads this after you answer the request.
ask.withdrawUnknown: This may have been taken back.
ask.withdrawTaken: Already sent to your agent, so it can't be taken back.
ask.withdrawOff: Your agent reads this at its next step. It can't be taken back here.
ask.withdrawClosed: The chat ended before this could be taken back.
ask.withdrawFailed: Couldn't take it back. Your agent still reads it at its next step.
ask.withdrawn: Taken back. It won't be sent.
ask.superseded: Not delivered: a newer message or Stop came first.
ask.refused: Your agent did not take this message.
ask.refusedHook: A rule on the agent refused this message.
ask.checkFailed: Couldn't check what happened to this message.
ask.followLost: Its text and files aren't kept after a reload. If it doesn't show in the conversation once the agent reads it, send it again.
ask.reachedAgent: Reached the agent. Its text shows in the conversation once the turn ends.
ask.cannotTell: Something else already reached the agent under this message's place, so whether this one did can't be told from here. Look for it in the conversation.
ask.tooOld: Sent too long ago to check from here. Look for it in the conversation.
ask.retypeSameKey: Its text and files aren't kept after a reload. Type it again and send: it goes with the same key, so it can't run twice.
ask.alreadyThere: An earlier message already reached the agent in its place. Send again to send this one as a new message.
ask.autoOffFailed: Allow everything could not be turned off, so nothing was sent. Try again.
ask.autoOffUnchecked: Allow everything could not be turned off, so this was not checked again. Use Check status once it is off.
ask.notRemembered: This browser could not keep a record of this send, so nothing was sent. Check that it may store data for this site, then send again.
ask.checkEarlier: Check the earlier sends first. This browser holds as many unfinished sends as it can keep; this one was not sent.
ask.noResend: This may have gone through. It is never sent a second time; look for it in the conversation.
ask.tooManyQueued: Several messages are still waiting for the agent. Wait until it reads them, then send again.
ask.framed: The Agent panel can't send from inside another page.
ask.signFail: Could not sign this agent in. Sign it in from the Agent app.
ask.signNotOffered: This agent doesn't accept sign-in from the Hub. Sign it in from the Agent app, then send again.
ask.signInInAgent: Sign this agent in from the Agent app, then send again.
ask.signUnknown: The agent may have been signed in, but we couldn't confirm it, so the message wasn't sent. Send again to check, or sign it in from the Agent app.
ask.signCancelled: Not signed in, so the message wasn't sent. Nothing was changed.
ask.signBusy: Sign-in is still finishing elsewhere. Try again in a moment.
ask.signShared: You're using shared access. Only the account's owner can sign this agent in.
ask.signAdmin: An administrator account can't sign agents in from the Hub. Sign it in in the Agent app.
ask.bindingFailed: The agent opened the conversation somewhere else, so nothing was sent.
ask.claudeUnavailable: The realm's default agent is not available on this computer.
ask.notOpened: The conversation did not open. Send again.
ask.keyReused: This message may already be on the agent. Open Recent to find it.
ask.sendingElsewhere: Another tab may still be sending this. Check again in a moment.
ask.createStarting: The chat is still starting on this computer. Check again in a moment.
ask.checkOnly: Its text and files aren't kept after a reload. Check status finds out whether it went through; it is never sent again.
ask.createSaving: The chat was found, but this browser could not save it yet. Check again in a moment. Your message was not sent.
ask.createMayExist: A chat may have been started on this computer without your first message. The agent discards such a chat after 5 minutes. Your message was not sent.
ask.createNotMade: No chat was made; your message was not sent.
ask.createUnopenable: A chat was started on this computer but cannot be opened now; your message was not sent.
ask.firstElsewhere: This message may still be sent from another tab or window. Look for it in the conversation, or stop tracking it.
ask.chatMissing: This browser has lost track of the chat, so nothing was sent. Check status looks for it.
ask.takenElsewhere: Another tab or window took over this conversation first, so this message was not sent. Send it again.
ask.handedOff: Not sent from here: the chat was opened elsewhere. Your text is back in the message box; press Send to send it.
ask.attachFailed: The chat could not be opened on the computer, so your message was not sent. Send it again.
ask.attachGone: This chat is no longer on the computer, so your message was not sent. Start a new chat to go on.
ask.helperGatesOff: This chat was started without helper approvals, so it could not be reopened here and your message was not sent.
ask.defaultUnread: The realm's default for new chats could not be read, so nothing was sent. Send it again.
ask.lockUnavailable: This browser could not make sure that no other tab is sending here, so nothing was sent. Try again in a moment.
ask.createNoMessage: The chat was made, but your first message was not sent. Write it again to send it.
ask.notSentReadGone: Nothing ran. Its text isn't kept after a reload: write it again to send it.
ask.stepHeld: Blocked by hooks in this computer's settings.
ask.stepUnknown: No result came back, so it may have run. Check before running it again.
ask.hooksTitle: A hook is holding the agent
ask.hooksBody: Hooks in this computer's settings stop the agent's steps until someone trusts them. You check and trust them in the Agent app.
ask.hooksOpenAgent: Open the Agent app to trust these hooks
ask.replyCut: The rest of this reply is in the Agent app.
ask.otherTab: Another tab sent a message here before this one, and whether it reached the agent can't be told from here. Look for it in the conversation, or stop tracking it.
ask.dormant: This chat is asleep on the computer. Your next message wakes it.
ask.policyChanged: The approval policy changed while your agent waited. Continue in the Agent app.
ask.o.cancelled: Stopped. Earlier steps may have run.
ask.o.interrupted: Interrupted. Earlier steps may have run.
ask.o.failed: Your agent could not finish this task. Try again, or tell it what to do differently.
ask.o.unsure: Couldn't tell how this task ended: it may have failed or finished.
ask.stopUnsure: Stop may have gone through. The task still showed as running when it was last read.
ask.modeUnread.title: Approval setting not read
ask.modeUnread: Whether this agent asks before it acts could not be read. Approvals are held to Ask every time until it can be.
ask.noModel: No usable model is set on this computer. Choose one in AI models.
ask.tooLong: This conversation got too long for the model. Start a new one, or pick a model that can hold more.
ask.rateLimited: The model is busy or at its limit. Wait a minute, then try again.
ask.rateLimitedAt: The model is busy or at its limit. Try again at {{time}}.
ask.gap: Some earlier steps are no longer available.
ask.shotNoServer: Where {{computer}} runs isn't known yet, so its displays can't be reached.
ask.attLinesFrom: {{n}} lines · goes in as text · from {{from}}
ask.attLinesFrom_one: {{n}} line · goes in as text · from {{from}}
ask.attImgBig: {{name}} is {{size}}. Images can be up to 4 MB, and this one couldn't be made smaller to fit.
ask.attImgMany: {{name}} wasn't added: up to 4 images go with one message.
ask.attBodyFull: {{name}} wasn't added: the message would be too big to send (about 7.5 MB in all).
ask.attTextBig: {{name}} is {{size}}. Text files up to 24 KB go into the message; for a bigger one, tell your agent where it is on the computer, or put it there with Files.
ask.attNotText: {{name}} isn't an image or a text file.
ask.attTextMany: {{name}} wasn't added: up to 3 text files go with one message.
ask.attTextFull: {{name}} wasn't added: the message with its text files would pass 28 KB.
ask.attSkipped: {{name}} wasn't read: up to 10 files at a time.
ask.attImgLater: Images go with your next message, once your agent is done.
ask.attTooLong: The message with its files is too big to send. Remove a file or shorten the text.
ask.attLostFirst: A message from before the reload is still waiting for its text. Send that one first, then send these files with a new message.
ask.attDropped: The files you had attached were dropped with the old conversation.
ask.attImgBroken: {{name}} looks like an image but can't be read as one, so it wasn't added.
ask.attReading: Reading your files. Send waits until they're added.
ask.attDroppedClosed: The files you had attached were let go when the panel closed. Add them again to send them.
ask.attRefused: Your agent didn't accept the files with this message. Use Edit to fix them and send it again.
ask.autoTurnLater: Automatic approval for one reply works only for a new reply when the chat is idle.
ask.autoTurnUnavailable: Automatic approval for one reply isn't available in this window.
ask.autoTurnStrict: Not sent: this chat asks every time, so nothing is approved for you. Send it without automatic approval for this reply.
ask.lostFiles: A message from before the reload had files, which aren't kept. Check its status or look for it in the conversation first; if it didn't reach your agent, stop tracking it and send it again with its files.
ask.lostFilesOther: Its text and files aren't kept after a reload, so it can't be sent again in its place. If it isn't in the conversation, stop tracking it and send it again with its files.
ask.lostFilesRow: Its text and files aren't kept after a reload, so it can't be sent again in its place. Check status; if it didn't reach your agent, stop tracking it and send it again with its files.
ask.forkMade: The answer was lost, so the fork may have been made.
ask.forkNotOpen: This chat is not open on the computer, so nothing was made. Open it again, then fork it.
ask.forkNoTurn: This chat has no finished reply yet, so there is nothing to fork. Nothing was made.
ask.forkReopenFailed: This chat could not be reopened on the computer, so nothing was made. Try again.
ask.forkReopenGates: This chat was started without helper approvals, so it could not be reopened here to fork. Nothing was made.
ask.forkReopenUnconfirmed: The computer did not confirm this chat is open again, so no fork was made. Try again.
ask.forkStateUnread: Whether this chat is open on the computer could not be read, so nothing was made. Try again.
ask.forkAccountMoved: The account changed while this fork was starting, so nothing was made.
ask.forkChanged: This chat changed since you opened it, so nothing was made. Reload it and fork again.
ask.forkApproval: This chat's approval setting is locked and does not allow a fork. Nothing was made.
ask.forkNotRead: This chat's turns could not be read, so nothing was made. Try again.
ask.forkFull: Too many forks are unconfirmed. Check them first.
ask.forkPending: A fork from this reply is not confirmed yet.
ask.forkPendingWhole: A fork of this chat is not confirmed yet.
ask.forkBusy: This fork is busy. Try again in a moment.
ask.forkInFlight: The computer is still making this fork.
ask.forkHandoff: The fork was made, but this page could not record it.
ask.forkNone: No fork was made from this reply.
ask.forkNoneWhole: No fork of this chat was made.
ask.forkGone: The fork was made but cannot be opened here.
ask.forkElsewhere: The agent's reply says the fork runs on another computer, realm or account, so it is not opened here and nothing is sent to it.
ask.forkMarksFull: This browser can't fork more chats: too many earlier forks ran on another computer, realm or account. To fork again, use Remove all local data in Account settings.
ask.chatElsewhere: This chat now runs on another computer, realm or account, so nothing more is sent to it from here. Start a new chat.
ask.forkUnconfirmed: The fork could not be confirmed. Look in your chat list.
ask.forkUntracked: This fork is no longer tracked on this page.
ask.forkUnreadable: This page could not read its saved forks. Reload it.
ask.forkAccount: The account changed. Open the fork's account and check again.
ask.startNotReady: The agent on this computer isn't ready to start a chat yet.
ask.startBusy: A new chat is still being started here.
ask.startUnresolved: An earlier new chat here may have been made. Check it before you start another.
ask.startNotSent: Nothing was sent. Send it again.
